description: FAILED and withdrawn (2026-10-26): RQ2 fidelity pilot for the reasoning_effort=low deviation (PREREGISTRATION section 12, 2026-10-26). NOT confirmatory and never pooled with rq2a: one judge-free retail test task outside RQ2's first 12 (task 53; its personas are lisa_en_v1 / rishika_hindi_v1, the ones 10 of RQ2's 12 tasks get) x 1 trial x the 3 RQ2 arms, with exactly the RQ2 settings. Pass criteria were fixed before the run: no merged_turns and no first_turn_stop in any arm, hi_romanized script-leak share <= 0.5, every transcript read by hand. Rewards are not used for the decision. Result: en_pack merged turns at customer turn 2 and hi_romanized ended the call at turn 2; the ablation showed the persona block, not the reasoning effort, is the cause (docs/RESULTS_LOG.md). Kept only as the record of that pilot; do not run.

simulators.name: gptoss120b
simulators.notes: Groq free plan: 200K tokens/day for this model, shared with the RQ1 gptoss120b runs on the same day. The per-condition estimates below replace tokens_per_task_estimate. reasoning_effort low added 2026-10-26 (PREREGISTRATION section 12): at the default (medium) effort gpt-oss-120b merged several turns into one message or sent ###STOP### in its first message in 6 of 8 first-turn calls with the en pack persona lisa_en_v1 (0 of 4 at low, 0 of 4 at high); see docs/RESULTS_LOG.md.

conditions.name: en_pack
conditions.notes: English language pack (matched control: same persona machinery as the Hindi arms). Estimate = RQ1 gpt-oss-120b English cost (11,812 measured) padded ~10%.

conditions.name: hi_native
conditions.notes: Hindi in Devanagari (the branch default style). Estimate raised 35K -> 42K on 2026-10-20 (gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8-27b's tokens in English); re-measure after the first chunk.

conditions.name: hi_romanized
conditions.notes: Estimate: 31,458 user tokens measured in ONE smoke simulation (task 0_hi, qwen3.8-27b simulator), padded ~10%. gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8's tokens in English, so ~42K is possible: re-measure after chunk 1. Smoke: 7 of 8 customer turns had Devanagari although style=romanized; check style compliance before reading this arm as romanized. Estimate raised 35K -> 42K on 2026-10-20 (gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8-27b's tokens in English); re-measure after the first chunk.

conditions.name: hi_code_mixed
conditions.notes: Hinglish code-mixed. Same unmeasured-for-gpt-oss caveat as hi_romanized. Estimate raised 35K -> 42K on 2026-10-20 (gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8-27b's tokens in English); re-measure after the first chunk.
